1.w: For the one directing. According to “The Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to the soul.

2.w: I sink in the mire of the deep, and there is no place to stand; I have come into the depths of the waters, and a flood washes over me.

3.w: I have grown weary with my calling out; my throat is dry; my eyes fail, waiting for my God.

4.w: Those hating me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those seeking my destruction, my enemies [with] deception! That which I did not steal, I must then return.

5.w: O God, You know of my foolishness, and my guilt [is] not hidden from You.

6.w: Do not let those waiting on You come to shame because of me, O Lord YHWH of hosts; do not let those seeking You be disgraced because of me, O God of Israel!

7.w: [It is] for Your sake that I have carried scorn, [and] shame has covered my face.

8.w: I have become a stranger to my brothers, and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.

9.w: For zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those insulting You have fallen on me.

10.w: I even wept in the fasting of my soul, and it was for a reproach to me.

11.w: I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became to them as a byword.

12.w: Those sitting [at] the gate meditate against me, and I am the song of those drinking wine.

13.w: And I—my prayer [is] to You, O YHWH; [in] the time of favor, O God, in the abundance of Your loving devotion, may You answer me in the truth of Your salvation!

14.w: Deliver me from the mire, that I should not sink! May I be delivered from those hating me, and out of the depths of the waters.

15.w: Do not let the flood of waters engulf me, and do not let the deep swallow me up, and do not let the pit shut its mouth over me!

16.w: Answer me, O YHWH, for good [is] Your loving devotion; according to the abundance of Your tender mercies, turn to me.

17.w: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, for distress [is] unto me; hurry to answer me!

18.w: Draw near to my soul [and] redeem it; on account of my enemies, may You ransom me.

19.w: You know my scorn, and my shame, and my disgrace; all my adversaries [are] before You.

20.w: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick. And I looked for a bemoaner, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.

21.w: And they gave gall for my food, and for my thirst they made me drink vinegar.

22.w: May their table before them become a snare, and for a recompense—for a trap!

23.w: May their eyes grow dark from seeing, and their backs be bent forever!

24.w: Pour out upon them Your indignation, and may the burning of Your anger overtake them!

25.w: May their encampment become desolate; may there be no one dwelling in their tents.

26.w: For You—the one whom You struck—they pursue, and the pain of those You pierced they recount.

27.w: May You add iniquity to their iniquity, and do not let them come into Your righteousness!

28.w: May they be blotted out from the book of the living, and do not let them be written with the righteous!

29.w: And I [am] afflicted and pained; may Your salvation, O God, set me on high.

30.w: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will I magnify Him with thanksgiving.

31.w: And it is better to YHWH than an ox, a bull horned [and] hoofed.

32.w: The humble have seen—they rejoice—you seeking God, your⁺ heart shall live!

33.w: For YHWH listens to the needy, and he has not despised His captives.

34.w: Let the heavens and earth shout praise to Him, the seas, and every moving thing in them.

35.w: For God will save Zion, and He will rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.

36.w: And the seed of His servants will inherit it, and those loving His name will settle in it.
